init_ImageTokenizer: initialize an ImageTokenizer with a config YAML path and model checkpoint path
encode_img_tokens_from_pil: encode a PIL Image into discrete image tokens using the VQGAN model
decode_pil_from_img_toks: decode image tokens back into a PIL Image using the VQGAN codebook and decoder
whiten_transparency: blend a PIL Image with transparency onto a white background and convert to RGB
prepare_vqgan_input: resize, center crop, and normalize a PIL Image into a VQGAN input tensor
